types.name: AspectRatioProps
types.doc: A box that keeps a width to height ratio. Change `ratio` and the box springs to the new shape while the media inside stays covered, so a preview can move between landscape, square and portrait without a jump.

members.name: ratio
members.doc: Width divided by height. A number (`16 / 9`) or a string such as `"16/9"`, `"16:9"` or `"1.85"`.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Tallest the box may get, in px or any CSS length. Past it the box narrows instead of growing, so a portrait ratio never pushes the page down.

members.name: fit
members.doc: How direct media children (img, video, canvas, iframe) fill the box.

members.name: radius
members.doc: Corner style: `panel` uses the panel radius, `none` leaves the corners square.

members.name: animated
members.doc: Set to false to switch ratios instantly. Reduced motion always switches instantly.

members.name: onRatioSettled
members.doc: Runs when the box has settled on a new ratio.

members.name: children
members.doc: Media or any content. Direct media children are stretched over the box; other children are laid out by you.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.

members.name: style
members.doc: Inline styles for the root element, for sizes and CSS variables.
